description: The container keeps an empty line of its own in every line: a 32px span alone under a 30px line-height makes a 36px line, not 30.

classification.reason: Measured against Chrome 155 on Windows: 3.19% of the pixels differ and the box matches exactly; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Before each run's line box was measured on its own, the same fixture measured 9.4% and the box is 6px short, so it fails.
